item.subject: science
item.stem: Ritu blows through a straw into a glass of clear lime water in her kitchen at home. After some time, the lime water turns milky. Why is this milky appearance evidence that carbon dioxide is present and a chemical change has taken place?

options.A: The milkiness is a new insoluble substance, calcium carbonate, formed when carbon dioxide reacts with calcium hydroxide
options.B: The milkiness appears because carbon dioxide dissolves in the water and makes it cloudy
options.C: The milkiness shows that the water has evaporated when warm air is blown into it
options.D: The milkiness is calcium hydroxide settling down at the bottom of the glass
